result:
If I could change one thing, I'd make self-deception impossible for humans.

Not harder. Not less common. Structurally impossible. No more comforting lies you tell yourself about your motives, your competence, your relationships, your politics, or your future. Every time someone tried to maintain a false belief about themselves or reality, it would simply fail to stick. The mind would reject it the way it rejects trying to breathe underwater.

Most of the world's persistent problems aren't caused by lack of intelligence or resources. They're caused by people being able to hide from what they know is true, then building entire lives, institutions, and ideologies on top of that hiding. Remove the hiding, and a lot of the downstream damage becomes much harder to sustain. 

It wouldn't create utopia. It would just remove the single most reliable engine for sustained stupidity.
